plainText:
Shulin (Japanese: シュリン Shulin) is a minor recurring character in . She is a Pokémon Performer.

==History==
Shulin first appeared in Master Class Choices!, where she competed in the Fleurrh City Rookie Class Pokémon Showcase. However, she was ranked fourth out of the final five competitors.

She reappeared in Master Class Is in Session!, where she entered the Gloire City Master Class Pokémon Showcase. She participated in the first round, among the third group of Performers, with her , but was eliminated.
